scores.sql: SELECT FLOOR(score/50)*50 AS lower_score,COUNT(*) AS candidate_count,SUM(admitted_batch IS NOT NULL) AS admitted_count FROM app_candidate_results WHERE run_id=%s GROUP BY FLOOR(score/50)*50 ORDER BY lower_score

juniors.sql: SELECT junior_code,COUNT(*) AS candidate_count,SUM(admitted_batch IS NOT NULL) AS admitted_count FROM app_candidate_results WHERE run_id=%s GROUP BY junior_code ORDER BY junior_code
